hints.title: Alternating Extremes Difference Generator
hints.text: Alternating between the smallest and largest remaining numbers in a range produces consecutive unique differences k, k-1, k-2, ..., 1.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Zigzag Assignment
hints.text: For the first k + 1 elements, alternate picking from left = 1 and right = k + 1 using a boolean flag.

hints.title: Monotonic Suffix Padding
hints.text: The remaining n - (k + 1) elements from k + 2 through n can be appended in simple ascending order, contributing only duplicate difference 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations and validating differences takes O(N!) time and overflows.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructive dual-pointer alternating pattern constructs the exact valid sequence in a single O(N) pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize how interleaving low and high endpoints generates exactly k distinct differences.
